name: nerd-offline-task-manager
description: Offline-first desktop task manager built with Electron, TypeScript and SQLite, with JSON import/export and optional Firebase Firestore cloud sync.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run rebuild:electron && electron .
